name: Unified Threat-Informed Operations Model
author: Reza Adineh

phases.name: Vision
phases.legend: Why the SOC exists and how success is measured.

phases.name: Strategy
phases.legend: The security operations strategy: threat profiling, risk prioritisation, capability roadmap.

phases.name: Crown Jewels
phases.legend: Critical asset mapping, threat modelling, attack paths.

phases.name: Threat Visibility
phases.legend: Telemetry engineered outward from crown jewels.

doctrine.title: Business survival defines security
doctrine.blurb: Every material capability must be justified by business consequence, relevant threat or operational resilience.

doctrine.title: Strategy before sensors
doctrine.blurb: Telemetry and tools must follow strategy. Architecture is driven by intent, not by vendor capability.

doctrine.title: Crown jewels drive prioritisation
doctrine.blurb: Resources are finite. Crown jewels determine where visibility, detection and response must be strongest.

doctrine.title: Threats shape architecture
doctrine.blurb: Detection engineering must be informed by real adversary behaviour, designed around realistic attack paths.

doctrine.title: Visibility is a design decision
doctrine.blurb: Blind spots are not accidents. They are architectural choices.

doctrine.title: Operations is continuous response
doctrine.blurb: Incident response is not a phase. It is the operating state of modern security operations.

doctrine.title: Improvement is mandatory
doctrine.blurb: Every incident must refine the system, through measurable feedback loops.
